thread:
Tara: Heads-up — bulk role-bind optimizer ran overnight and generated 12k candidate bindings for tenant z-9. Console got very slow for that tenant this morning.
Owen: Can you share logs? Sounds like optimizer may be expanding wildcard scopes too aggressively.
Tara: Logs show it materialized per-route role bindings for routes that should be covered by a single scope pattern. Example: `scope:projects/alpha/routes/*` got expanded to 8,000 explicit bindings.
Devon: Telemetry: rolebind.create API spiked x20. Quota alerts fired: 
```
quota-meter: tenant z-9: rolebinds_created=12000
HTTP 429 POST /v1/rolebinds -> 429
```
Ming (Console): UX-wise we need a throttled progress state and a bulk-preview before commit. Users clicked "apply all" and console attempted to render the full mutation set which froze the browser.
quota-bot: alert: tenant z-9 exceeded rolebind write quota; auto-throttle engaged.
Owen: Backend root cause: optimizer treats parameterized segments as distinct (e.g., /items/123 vs /items/:id). We should canonicalize then emit pattern-level binds not per-instance.
Tara: Proposal: change optimizer to emit pattern-scoped suggestions when pattern coverage > 90% of routes, otherwise show grouped candidate with sample. Also add a safety limit: cap suggested explicit bindings to 200; beyond that require user confirmation with an "I understand the scope" checkbox.
Devon: Instrumentation: add metrics `optimizer.suggestions_grouped`, `optimizer.expanded_count`, `rolebind.429s`. Add a dashboard tile for canary cohort showing these.
Ming (Console): For console: show a diff preview with counts ("This will add 8,000 explicit bindings OR 1 pattern binding covering 96% of routes — recommended"). Lazy-render the expanded list behind a "Show details" button to avoid DOM spikes. Also provide an "export preview CSV" link.
Owen: Rollout: behind flag `optimizer.pattern_prefer` default true for tenants with > 500 routes; start at 5% canary. We should also update tenant quotas docs since grouping reduces write burn.
quota-bot: note: throttling removed after automatic rollback at 1797771300.
Tara: Tests: unit tests for canonicalizer, integration test comparing pattern vs expanded outputs, e2e where console backs out if browser CPU > 80%.
Devon: I'll add the telemetry panels and an alert: if `rolebind.429s` rises above threshold during canary -> rollback.
Ming (Console): I'll draft mocks and microcopy for the confirmation checkbox and the preview diff.
Tara: Action items: Owen (optimizer patch + canon), Devon (dashboard + alerts), Ming (console preview + checkbox), I'll write RFC and coordinate canary.
Owen: on it.
Ming (Console): mock uploaded: https://figma.com/s/optimizer-preview (private). :thumbsup:
